summary: Validated Phase-2 voice/session persistence gap closure on public URL: GET /api/voice/sessions returns student-scoped sessions, /api/student/export includes voice_sessions, and Voice Studio UI session history updates after starting a session. No provider-ready regressions observed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is currently very large (>700 lines), which increases maintenance and regression risk; split by domain routers/services in a follow-up refactor.
seed_data_creation: Created student voice session records during backend/API and UI tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Student voice sessions now verifiable via GET /api/voice/sessions and /api/student/export.voice_sessions; Voice Studio history list increments after Start session. Provider-ready note/status remained intact.
rca of the issue: Previous gap was a contract-level observability issue (missing read path/export field), not runtime instability. Current implementation resolves RCA by exposing user-scoped voice session retrieval and including voice_sessions in student export.
